statements.C:algebraic_field_arithmetic: PASS. Full actual written proof independently read. Finite subfield degrees are divisor/lcm closed, determining the supernatural degree. A division algebra multiplication table descends to a finite unital subring with no zero divisors, hence a finite field by Wedderburn, so the whole division algebra is commutative. Finite extensions are composita and preserve finiteness versus infinitude of the global 2-height. Square classes, symmetric rank/determinant and finite quadratic norm surjectivity are proved from finite fields; the fixed-field norm argument includes coefficients of a nonfixed element.
statements.C:all_algebraic_fields_WG: PASS. Frobenius image is generated by gcd(n,N), with recanonicalization, and changing the finite coefficient field does not change the orbit. Perfect descent and commutative residual division algebras give exactly one module per orbit and Schur index one. Restriction to F_(p^g) yields an isotypic module whose chosen summand stays indecomposable. For general End centers n_j=rd_j, g_j=gcd(n_j,N), b=lcm g_j, one has gcd(b,n_j)=g_j and gcd(lcm(b,n_j),N)=b; thus all finite-stage residual factors stay fields over k. Radical base change, primitive summands, finite-field reference forms and residual Gram extraction compute operations. Concrete square tests use finite membership decisions; the global 2-height datum is explicitly needed for the uniform bit convention and chosen nonsquare. No arbitrary-presentation arithmetic algorithm is claimed.
statements.C:algebraic_fields_scalar: PASS. Rank and determinant give Z or Z plus one order-two bit. Equal determinants imply <a,a> isometric to <1,1>, hence 2t=0; <a> squared is 1, hence t squared is zero. The virtual exterior generating series yields binomial(n,r)+b binomial(n-1,r-1)t for every integer n, including negative n.
